instruction: Write a Graphoid function that partitions a list into two based on a predicate

fn partition(items, pred) {
    yes = items.filter(pred)
    no = items.reject(pred)
    return [yes, no]
}

print(result[0])  # [2, 4, 6]
print(result[1])  # [1, 3, 5]

    total = numbers.reduce(0, fn(acc, x) { return acc + x })
    return {
        "min": sorted.first(),
        "max": sorted.last(),
        "sum": total,
        "count": numbers.length(),
        "mean": total / numbers.length()
    }
}

lines = csv_data.split("\n")

records = []
i = 1
while i < lines.length() {
    values = lines[i].split(",")
    record = {}
    j = 0
    while j < headers.length() {
        record[headers[j]] = values[j]
        j = j + 1
    }

    i = i + 1
}

Write a Graphoid program that implements a simple calculator using match

fn calculate(expr) {
    parts = expr.split(" ")
    a = parts[0].to_num()
    op = parts[1]
    b = parts[2].to_num()

    return match op {
        "+" => a + b,
        "-" => a - b,
        "*" => a * b,
        "/" => a / b,
        _ => "unknown operator: " + op
    }
}

print(calculate("10 + 5"))   # 15
print(calculate("20 * 3"))   # 60
print(calculate("100 / 4"))  # 25

                .add_rule(:validate_range, 0, 50)
